title: containment-attestation.v1
description: Containment attestation from the verified launcher to the supervisor and broker. Authority is narrower than the grant; only verified read coverage can support complete access attestation. Missing, unverifiable, or broader enforcement refuses. Security owners approve guarantees; adapters cannot omit required denial or coverage.
$comment: Owned by: docs/specs/acceptance-authority-and-evidence/. Extended additively by: docs/specs/verified-infrastructure-parallelism/. Architecture: docs/architecture/runtime-security-primitives.md §4.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Security owners approve guarantees; unknown versions refuse.

host_mechanism.description: Host isolation mechanism (e.g., os-sandbox, restricted-principal, verified-container). Same-process wrappers are not permitted.

principal_or_sandbox.description: Identity of the security principal or sandbox instance that enforces the containment.

roots.description: Filesystem roots the contained child may access. Must be narrower than the grant.

read_enforcement.description: Enforced product read mode. Absent means read access is not proven complete.

trace_coverage.description: Description of trace coverage when read_enforcement is trace.

network.description: Network access attested by this containment. Absent means no network access is attested.

allowed.description: Whether network access is attested for the contained child.

children.description: Child-process authority attested by this containment. Absent means no child processes are attested.

allowed.description: Whether child processes are attested for the contained child.

limits.description: Resource limits attested by this containment.

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes attested for the contained child.

timeout_s.description: Wall-clock timeout in seconds attested for the contained child.

binding.description: Attempt binding the launcher echoes. Absent for a containment not bound to one attempt.

launcher_sha256.description: sha256 of the pinned launcher, lowercase hex.

items.description: Repository path: relative, `/` separators, no empty, `.` or `..` component, no NUL, control character, or backslash.

read_allowlist.description: Repository paths the contained child may read. Present with read_enforcement allowlist.

write_roots.description: Roots the contained child may write.

denied.description: Locations the containment denies the contained child.
